audit.why: Lane difficulty is correctly read as an early Alistar advantage into a late Taric advantage, but the level chart (phases[].side) said 'Skill' at every stage while win[] and the packet both said Alistar wins L1-4 and Taric wins first-item/late.
audit.corrected: Chart rows re-aligned to Alistar-favored L1-3, Alistar-leaning L4-5, even L6, Taric-favored on items — matching win[] and packet.levelChart exactly.

audit.why: Power spikes are already correctly named: Alistar's level-2 Q-W combo, Taric's level-6 Cosmic Radiance flip, and the first-item Bastion sustain spike.
audit.corrected: Kept spikes[] as-is; only tightened breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers per lintFindings.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Headbutt as 'matchup-defining' with no digit, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles instead of stating their own interaction.
audit.why: Headbutt/Pulverize are both 14/13/12/11/10s on cooldown — the exact number tells you when the combo is actually gone. Cosmic Radiance has a real ~2.5s cast delay before the invuln lands, and Alistar's Trample (E) silently stacks to a stun — neither fact was on the page anywhere.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries real numbers for both Headbutt and Cosmic Radiance; dosFull[1] states the R's cast-delay timing; dontsFull[2] states the Trample stack-to-stun tell.

edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: Alistars instant Q-W knockup beats your telegraphed kit -- no answer at level 1.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: His level-2 combo lands before your answer does.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: Full kit online, but he still bursts faster than your E can peel -- tempo stays his.

edits.before: Stun the margins off the link's geometry — their spacing answers two Tarics.
edits.after: His single-target Headbutt pick threat on your ADC outpaces your slower setup.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: First item: your Bastion armor out-values his combo.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.
edits.after: Late Taric un-kills fights: Bastion links and Bravado sustain out-peel his repeated Headbutt engage.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your R Cosmic Radiance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Alistar Headbutt: 14s at rank 1, down to 10s by rank 5 — the headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play; respect flash range while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your R Cosmic Radiance is 180s at rank 1, 120s at rank 3 — spend it only on swing moments.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance has a ~2.5s cast delay before invulnerability lands — start it as Headbutt-Pulverize connects, not after.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Trample stacks silently to a stun — once he has tagged the wave twice, his next auto locks your ADC down.

notes: Chart was fully mirrored to win[]/packet (win[] itself needed no edits since it already agreed with the packet). missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal' (Triumphant Roar sustain) is already implicitly covered by report[8] itemization ('Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain'); left as-is rather than forcing a duplicate edit.
